description.value:
The Art of the Libra Shields.

Frequency once per round

Requirements You are wielding both @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra Shield (Right)] and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra Shield (Left)]

While wielding both Shields you may Raise a Shield as a free action once per round — this action — and you can Shield Block as a reaction even without the feat, which the Art grants you outright.

Each Shield has Hardness equal to your level, Hit Points equal to 8 × your level, and a Broken Threshold of half that. A Shield reduced to 0 Hit Points is not destroyed but returns to the Cloth and can be re-summoned after 1 minute.

Greater (8th level) You may Shield Block twice per round (the second use costs no reaction), and may use it for an adjacent ally.

Perfect (14th level) You may Shield Block for any ally within 15 feet, and whenever a Block reduces the damage to 0 the attacker takes your Shield's damage dice in bludgeoning — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.The Twin Bulwark: Riposte].

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra — the Weapons].

Automation note: pf2e models no reaction budget, so the second Block each round and blocking for somebody else are the table's to count — as they are for every Bastion feat in the game. Everything the Shields themselves are is on the item: Hardness, Hit Points and Broken Threshold all follow your level, and pf2e's own Shield Block dialog does the rest.
